name: Eikonal SDF Refinement
definition: Corrects inaccurate SDF values near the zero-level set by solving the Eikonal equation $|\nabla \phi| = 1$ using a fast-marching style approach over neighboring voxels.
summary: Eikonal SDF Refinement corrects inaccurate Signed Distance Field values near the zero-level set by solving the Eikonal equation to enforce exact gradient magnitude constraints, unlike simple relaxation methods.
